prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A quick comparison of React and Vue for beginners choosing a first JavaScript framework. Learn what each offers and how to pick based on your goal.

beats.narration: Stuck choosing between React and Vue? Here's the truth: you can't really pick wrong. But one of them might fit you better.
React is hugely popular, so it has more jobs and more tutorials. It gives you freedom, but also more choices to make.
Vue is friendlier for beginners. Its structure is clear, and the docs are easy to follow, so you build something quickly.
Want a job fast? Start with React. Want an easy, enjoyable start? Pick Vue. Either way, the skills carry over. Just start.

props.text: Jobs? React. Easy start? Vue. Either way, just start.
